Autonomous Bodies for the same work [OR similar work as mentioned in Bid Document] for a minimu m of 35 percent of total bid value during previous three year. This period of three years shall be counted w ith respect to date of tender closing. The payment certificate duly signed by the Competent Authority shall be submitted by the Bidder. Certificates from Private Individuals shall not be accepted. 12. Cost offered would be inclusive of all tolls, parking charges, Night charges, etc. 14. The vehicle provided for services of this work must be Commercial Vehicle and also vehicle details sub mitted during bidding is deployed for executing service of this work. 15. Failure to comply with the above conditions will make the contract liable for termination, and the Performance Guarantee (PG) will be forfeited. Note-The successful bidder shall submit each bill along with a duly maintained log book, toll receipts, vehi cle deployment statement, and required documents etc. Payment shall be processed only after verification of the submitted documents. .
